description:
This smartphone videography course shows you how to shoot, edit and publish professional-looking videos with the phone already in your pocket.

Brands, churches, schools, event planners and small businesses across Nigeria need a steady supply of video for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and WhatsApp. Expensive cameras are no longer the barrier: knowing how to frame a shot, light a face, capture clean sound and cut a story together is. That is what this programme teaches, step by step, using equipment most people can afford.

## What the smartphone videography course covers

- **Filmmaking essentials.** Resolution and frame rates, slow motion, exposure, composition, shot sizes and camera movements such as pans, tilts and dollies.
- **The kit.** Which accessories make the biggest difference, including tripods, gimbals, Bluetooth remotes, microphones and lights, and how to get good results on a small budget.
- **Mobile videomaking.** Manual camera apps, locking focus and exposure, filming in different light, recording clean audio and planning shots before you press record.
- **Editing on your phone.** Trimming, ordering clips, J and L cuts, transitions, text, music and exporting with mobile editing apps such as CapCut, InShot and VN.
- **Editing with Filmora.** A full desktop workflow: timelines, cutting to the beat, colour correction and grading, titles and export settings.
- **Editing with iMovie.** Editing on a Mac, iPhone or iPad, with themes, transitions and audio clean-up.
- **Video marketing.** Planning content, platform formats, building an audience, using a website, finding your first clients and pricing your work.
- **Case studies.** Real projects such as studio product shots, unboxing videos, talking-head interviews and event highlights, from planning to final edit.

## How the programme works

You follow a guided 12-week plan that sets weekly goals: a group of short video lessons, practice straight after each one and a quiz at the end of every chapter. Each quiz is drawn from the lessons you have just watched, and every answer comes with a short explanation, so a wrong answer teaches you something instead of just costing you marks. If your weeks are unpredictable you can learn at your own pace instead, though most learners finish sooner with the plan.

Quizzes ask you to make the calls a videographer makes on set and in the edit: which frame rate gives smooth slow motion, which shot needs a gimbal, how to fix a dull clip. Short practice tasks after each chapter build a reel of your own work as you go.

## Tools you will use

You will use your own Android or iPhone, a manual camera app, a mobile editing app and, for desktop editing, Wondershare Filmora on Windows or Mac or iMovie on Apple devices. A small tripod and an inexpensive clip-on microphone are recommended but not required to start.

## Who it is for

The programme suits content creators who want to look more professional, small business owners who market on social media, aspiring event and wedding videographers and anyone who wants a creative skill they can sell. You do not need any filming or editing experience.

## After you finish

You will be able to plan, shoot and edit short films, product videos, interviews and social content that looks deliberate rather than accidental, and you will have a clear plan for turning that skill into paid work.

## Certificate and final exam

When you are ready, you can get your SkillsAir certificate. Once it is unlocked, you sit a timed final exam drawn from every chapter of the programme. Pass it and your certificate is issued with a verification link that employers and clients can check. Certified graduates can also apply for internship openings from our growing partner network, with no job guarantees.

Every learner also gets the free Freelancer’s Academy bonus course, which shows you how to set up a professional Fiverr profile and gigs so you can start finding paying clients for your new skills.

faq.question: Do I need an expensive phone?
faq.answer: No. Any recent phone that records in 1080p is enough to start. The course shows how to get the best from the phone you have.

faq.question: Do I need to buy equipment?
faq.answer: Not at first. A small tripod and a clip-on microphone make a big difference and are inexpensive, and the kit chapter explains what to buy and when.

faq.question: Can I do the whole course on my phone?
faq.answer: Most of it, yes. The Filmora and iMovie chapters use a computer or Apple device, but you can edit everything with mobile apps if you prefer.

faq.question: Will it help me find clients?
faq.answer: Yes. The video marketing chapter covers building a portfolio, finding first clients and planning content, and the Freelancer’s Academy bonus adds Fiverr strategies.

faq.question: What happens after I finish?
faq.answer: You can sit the final exam to earn your certificate. Certified graduates can apply for internship openings from our partner network, with no job guarantees.
